query:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Catch-22, Bob gets Moby Dick, and Claire gets The Great Gatsby.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Claire and Bob swap books. Then, Claire and Alice swap books. Finally, Bob and Claire swap books. At the end of the semester, Alice has
Options:
(A) Catch-22
(B) Moby Dick
(C) The Great Gatsby
note: UNLABELED external package; reference = first successful rollout; all other successful rollouts are omitted so the annotator view matches annotate.py

steps.content: Alice ends up with Moby Dick after the series of swaps.
Start from the end, trace the swaps backwards: Bob ends up with The Great Gatsby, so Claire must have given it to him in the last swap, giving Alice Moby Dick.

NOTE Claire ends up with Moby Dick after the final swap with Bob. Since the last swap involved Claire and Bob, and Claire didn't initially have Moby Dick, Claire must have given her book to Bob, meaning Bob had The Great Gatsby before this swap.
ANSWER Worker NOTE Before the final swap, Bob had The Great Gatsby
